notes: Natural S33 ambient (bg_natural/S33.webp): the office wall clock's seconds hand ticks; dust motes drift in the sunbeam from the window; the lindens outside the window sway; the light patch on the floor shimmers softly; after Q6C (the seeds in the park bowl) the ringed carrier pigeon sits in the pigeon window on its sill, above the landing board, pecking and looking around (Adam: 'it flies to the post office').
